Family-level assertion evidence for local failure reporting.
Local Http.send routes through an HttpCalloutMock registered by Test.setMock.

Local debug calls are accepted and recorded by the test runner.

source.content: public class CoreRuntimeSystemOperatingMock implements HttpCalloutMock { public HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest req) { System.assertEquals('https://example.test/system-closeout', req.getEndpoint()); System.assertEquals('POST', req.getMethod()); HttpResponse res = new HttpResponse(); res.setStatusCode(207); res.setStatus('Multi-Status'); res.setBody('mock:' + req.getBody()); return res; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeSystemOperatingCloseoutTest { @isTest static void assertionsPass() { System.assert(true); System.assertEquals('nook', 'nook'); System.Assert.areNotEqual('nook', 'trail'); System.Assert.isFalse(false); System.Assert.isTrue(true); System.Assert.isNull(null); System.Assert.isNotNull('spruce'); System.debug('system operating closeout'); } @isTest static void assertionFailureEvidence() { System.Assert.fail('forced fixture failure'); } @isTest static void userInfoContracts() { System.runAs(new User(Id = '005-user-a', ProfileId = '00e-profile-a', Username = 'user-a@example.test', LocaleSidKey = 'de_DE', LanguageLocaleKey = 'fr')) { System.assertEquals('005-user-a', UserInfo.getUserId()); System.assertEquals('00e-profile-a', UserInfo.getProfileId()); System.assertEquals('user-a@example.test', UserInfo.getUserName()); System.assertEquals('System User', UserInfo.getName()); System.assertEquals('System', UserInfo.getFirstName()); System.assertEquals('User', UserInfo.getLastName()); System.assertEquals('system@example.invalid', UserInfo.getUserEmail()); System.assertEquals('00D000000000001EAA', UserInfo.getOrganizationId()); System.assertEquals('', UserInfo.getSessionId()); System.assertEquals('de_DE', UserInfo.getLocale()); System.assertEquals('fr', UserInfo.getLanguage()); System.assertEquals(false, UserInfo.isMultiCurrencyOrganization()); System.assertEquals('Standard', UserInfo.getUserType()); } } @isTest static void httpMockAndSearchSuggest() { Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new CoreRuntimeSystemOperatingMock()); HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); req.setEndpoint('https://example.test/system-closeout'); req.setMethod('post'); req.setBody('body'); HttpResponse res = new Http().send(req); System.assertEquals(207, res.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Multi-Status', res.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('mock:body', res.getBody()); Search.SuggestionOption option = new Search.SuggestionOption(); Search.SuggestionResults suggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Account', option); System.assertEquals(0, suggestions.getSuggestionResults().size()); Search.SuggestionResults userSuggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Account', option, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(false, userSuggestions.hasMoreResults()); } }
